purpose: Improve the fixed 89-feature classifier using saved training rows only.
split_policy: Reuse saved train_ids/test_ids and related-text groups without resplitting. Selection may extract and fit only training rows.
primary_metric: pooled out-of-fold accuracy on texts passing the unchanged 50-word gate
test_policy: Freeze and commit the training-only selection before final fitting and test evaluation. Evaluate the winner once; never switch configurations based on test results. This is a previously published internal holdout, not a new unseen benchmark.
preprocessing_policy: All learned preprocessing is fitted within each training fold. HGB early stopping is disabled. No rule-score blending or test-based threshold tuning.
